answer: The European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) deliberately did not issue its 2024 generative AI guidelines in its role as AI Supervisor of the EU institutions under the EU's Artificial Intelligence Act. Instead, a separate strategy is being prepared for that capacity. The guidelines published by the EDPS in 2024 focus on helping EU institutions comply with data protection obligations under Regulation (EU) 2018/1725, but they are not issued within the AI Supervisor role related to the AI Act.
